working_geometry_plain: The working L5 geometry is a finite operator-substage cell layer carried by PEPS3D spinor-density anchors. The scout earns 64 finite substage cells as local tensor/channel actions over sheet, loop, terrain, and operator slot, then projects those cells to 16 sheet/loop/terrain placements with fiber size 4. This is still a local finite layer lego, not stacked manifold closure, Hopf shell closure, flux, Axis0, physics, or final manifold evidence.
